subject: ddl: limit the minimum region batch size in local sort (#64567)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for `pkg/ddl/backfilling_dist_scheduler.go` batching logic used by DXF add-index local sort (read-index + local ingest). Change caps effective node count to 3 in local-disk mode and enforces a minimum batch of 100 regions (or full table for <100 regions), reducing number of read-index subtasks/partial imports. Range splitting remains contiguous/non-overlapping (region-boundary based), and local ingest uses per-subtask allocated TS for distributed import locking; no correctness, data-consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or DDL state-machine regressions found in the touched scheduling path.
